request.description:
Updates child resource associations in a synchronization plan given a target parent association.
**Required privileges:**
- `Snapshot - Edit`
- `Link - View`

Privilege required ``` {"owner":"PLATFORM","targetDomain":"SNAPSHOTS","type":"VIEW","targetId":"*"} AND {"owner":"PLATFORM","targetDomain":"LINK","type":"VIEW","targetId":"*"} ```
